def transform(grid):
    # A vertical separator splits the patterned region from distractor noise.
    # Keep the region to its left and encode its foreground marks as color 2.
    sep = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value != 0 and all(row[i] == value for row in grid))
    return [[2 if cell != 0 else 0 for cell in row[:sep]] for row in grid]
